alt: A PlayStation 5 disc-edition console displayed in a locked glass case at a Japanese electronics store, with the Sony logo and PlayStation 5 branding visible
story: Sony announced on July 1, 2026 that physical disc production for all new PlayStation games will end in January 2028 — simultaneously with GTA 6 confirming that its $80 'physical edition' ships with only a download code in an empty cardboard box, with no disc ever planned.
why_funny: They engineered a beautifully slotted disc drive into millions of consoles, then announced the slot is now purely decorative.
